rules.retrieved_snippet: White & Case: age of consent is 13 for processing by or on behalf of information society services and 16 for processing students' personal data; the Information and Data Protection Commissioner is the competent supervisory authority. The statutory text of the age provision was not retrieved (official text at legislation.mt, ELI act/2021/12/eng).

rules.source: Criminal Code (Chapter 9), sub-title on computer misuse, Articles 337B to 337H — Council of Europe Octopus Malta profile https://www.coe.int/fr/web/octopus/-/malta
rules.retrieved_snippet: Council of Europe: the computer-misuse sub-title (Articles 337B-337H) covers the offences the Budapest Convention requires; Malta signed the Convention on 17 January 2002 and ratified on 12 April 2012; the procedural provisions mention search, seizure and production orders only in general terms. Detailed article wording not retrieved.
